WITH timing_averages AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
), above_average AS (
  SELECT t.avg_ownership, o.avg_ownership AS overall_ownership
  FROM timing_averages AS t
  CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
  WHERE t.avg_ownership > o.avg_ownership
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ownership) AS mean_timing_average_ownership,
       AVG(avg_ownership - overall_ownership) AS average_amount_above_overall
FROM above_average;
